title: One source, many pieces
when: You have a long video, podcast, talk or article and want a week of content from it.
summary: Find the best clips, cut, caption, adapt per platform, add text and carousel derivatives, check originality, schedule.

steps.title: Bring the source
steps.do: Give the transcript (SRT or text) and the video file name.

steps.title: Find the clips
steps.do: Score windows on hook, self-containment, density and payoff. Pick the top five.

steps.title: Cut list and captions
steps.do: Tighten dead air, re-chunk captions for vertical, generate the cut commands.

steps.title: Hook and caption per platform
steps.do: A different first line for each platform. Do not post identical copy everywhere.

steps.title: Text and carousel derivatives
steps.do: Turn two or three points into a text post and one carousel.

steps.title: Humanize and originality check
steps.do: Make sure each piece adds something of yours. Reposts of others' work are being demoted.

steps.title: Spread across the week
steps.do: Hub first, spokes the next day. Never everything at once.
